in_sanskrit.name: Baliddh
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Baliddh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'iddh' meaning achieved. The long meaning of the name is 'One who has achieved strength'.

in_hindi.name: बालिध
in_hindi.long_meaning: The name Baliddh in Hindi is translated as 'One who has reached or attained strength'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'iddh' meaning achieved.

in_tamil.name: பலித்த
in_tamil.long_meaning: The name Baliddh in Tamil is translated as 'One who has attained strength'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'iddh' meaning achieved.

in_telugu.name: బలిద్ద
in_telugu.long_meaning: The name Baliddh in Telugu is translated as 'One who has achieved strength'. It is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Bal' meaning strength and 'iddh' meaning achieved.

in_marathi.name: Baliddh
in_marathi.long_meaning: Baliddh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Baliddh is a Sanskrit name derived from the root word 'bal' which means strength or power. The suffix 'iddh' indicates achievement or attainment. This name is thus bestowed upon a boy who is expected to grow up to be strong, brave and valiant.
